'''The Airlock''' was a small [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] located on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[3DC/Green]]. It offered a selection of [[Foodstuff/Legends|dishes]] and was a favorite among [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] and crew alike.<ref name="HS" />
